correctness.rationale: For every p congruent to 5 mod 6 and nonzero A,B, the smoothness and genus follow from six simple degree-three branch points and three unramified infinite points. A separable Hermitian-to-Fermat-to-genus-four quotient forces scalar -p Frobenius on the untwisted curve. Four regular differentials and their inverse characters give eight distinct tame eigenspaces; the explicit beta/delta descent cocycle yields the eight polynomial signatures. All eighteen coefficient types were checked by separate finite-field arithmetic over F25, F121, F289 and F625 using src/verify.py. Finite tests do not substitute for the general proof.

value.rationale: A single geometric genus-four curve has an especially natural diagonal twisting family whose Jacobians exhibit eight genuinely different Weil polynomials but just four rational-point totals. These full intrinsic arithmetic invariants distinguish extension-field behavior and isolate the unique maximal diagonal type; their exact class-by-class classification is not supplied by superspeciality, Newton polygons, or the untwisted maximality theorem. The family and invariants have a structural Fermat/Hermitian motivation rather than an ad hoc slice.
